records.source: *sigh*... To live in a world of endless potential, we can never know if we've made the right choices.$s#$b#Sorry to trouble you, my dear. I sometimes get carried away by thoughts...
records.translation: *buntong-hininga*... Sa mundong walang hanggan ang mga posibilidad, hindi natin kailanman malalaman kung tama ang mga pinili natin.$s#$b#Paumanhin sa pag-abala sa iyo, mahal ko. Minsan ay nadadala ako ng mga iniisip ko...

records.source: Fruit, fish, and foraged food... It's a good diet! I feel as healthy as ever.
records.translation: Prutas, isda, at nakalap na pagkain... Mabuting diyeta ito! Pakiramdam ko ay napakalusog ko.

records.source: The weather is warm and lovely year round, my dear... it feels perfect for me bones...
records.translation: Mainit at kaaya-aya ang panahon buong taon, mahal ko... tamang-tama sa mga buto ko...

records.source: Have you seen the little banana altar in the jungle? If I had a banana I'd set it there and see what happens... heh heh...$h
records.translation: Nakita mo na ba ang munting altar ng saging sa gubat? Kung may saging ako, ilalagay ko iyon doon at titingnan kung ano ang mangyayari... heh heh...$h

records.source: Hello, dear... you look healthy and in good spirits today!$h
records.translation: Kumusta, mahal ko... mukha kang malusog at masigla ngayon!$h

records.source: I've been here so long, I can't even hear the ocean anymore...
records.translation: Napakatagal ko nang narito kaya hindi ko na nga naririnig ang karagatan...

records.source: It's a full moon, tonight... Whether your fortune be good or bad, be on the alert, my dear... The spirits are restless.
records.translation: Kabilugan ng buwan ngayong gabi... Mabuti man o masama ang kapalaran mo, manatiling mapagmatyag, mahal ko... Hindi mapakali ang mga espiritu.

records.source: Oh, no no no... I don't need any gifts, my dear. You keep it.
records.translation: O, hindi, hindi, hindi... Hindi ko kailangan ng anumang regalo, mahal ko. Itago mo iyan.

records.source: My research suggests that a species of frog once lived on this island. They would've inhabited a dark, damp area, with lots of vegetation...
records.translation: Ipinakikita ng pananaliksik ko na isang uri ng palaka ang dating nanirahan sa islang ito. Malamang na tumira sila sa madilim at mamasa-masang lugar na maraming halaman...

records.source: Long ago, a rare species of cave-bat made their home here. The evidence suggests they were adapted to tolerate intense heat. Interesting, huh?
records.translation: Matagal na ang nakalipas, isang bihirang uri ng paniki sa yungib ang nanirahan dito. Ipinakikita ng ebidensiya na nakaangkop sila upang matiis ang matinding init. Kawili-wili, hindi ba?

records.source: Hmm... My nose is telling me that snake spines might be found in the western region of the island.
records.translation: Hmm... Sinasabi ng ilong ko na maaaring matagpuan ang mga gulugod ng ahas sa kanlurang bahagi ng isla.

records.source: If you see something wiggling in the dirt, make sure to excavate it. You never know what might be under there!
records.translation: Kung may makita kang gumagalaw sa lupa, tiyaking hukayin iyon. Hindi mo malalaman kung ano ang maaaring nasa ilalim!

records.source: Before I got stuck in that cave, I was exploring the little gully nearby. The stones there are full of fossils! If I were you, I'd be breaking them open to look for bones.
records.translation: Bago ako nakulong sa kuwebang iyon, ginagalugad ko ang maliit na bangin sa malapit. Punô ng fossil ang mga bato roon! Kung ako sa iyo, babasagin ko ang mga iyon upang maghanap ng mga buto.

records.source: You know, I bet if you did some panning, you could find some interesting stuff in the nearby river.
records.translation: Alam mo, pustahan akong makakahanap ka ng mga kawili-wiling bagay sa kalapit na ilog kung magsasala ka.

records.source: You know, there's some great fishing on this island. From what I know, many of the fish enjoy nibbling on ancient bones...
records.translation: Alam mo, napakaganda ng pangingisda sa islang ito. Sa pagkakaalam ko, maraming isda ang gustong kumagat sa mga sinaunang buto...

records.source: Have you found any golden coconuts on the island? It's rumored that many interesting things can be found inside of them...
records.translation: Nakakita ka na ba ng anumang gintong niyog sa isla? May sabi-sabing maraming kawili-wiling bagay ang matatagpuan sa loob ng mga iyon...

records.source: Wow... Look at that view.
records.translation: Wow... Tingnan mo ang tanawing iyon.

records.source: You know, @... I've been mayor of Pelican Town for a long time.#$b#People have come and gone. We've lived through times of hardship, and times of plenty.
records.translation: Alam mo, @... Matagal na akong alkalde ng Bayan ng Pelican.#$b#May mga taong dumating at umalis. Naranasan natin ang mga panahon ng paghihirap at kasaganaan.

records.source: But I have to say, in all the years I've been mayor, nothing has made me so proud as seeing %farm Farm blossom under your care.$h#$b#You've taken the farm beyond the wildest dreams of your Grandfather.#$b#And in the process, you've changed the valley forever.
records.translation: Pero masasabi kong sa lahat ng taon ko bilang alkalde, wala nang higit na nagbigay sa akin ng pagmamalaki kaysa sa makitang umunlad ang %farm Farm sa pangangalaga mo.$h#$b#Dinala mo ang bukid nang lagpas sa pinakamapangahas na pangarap ng Lolo mo.#$b#At sa prosesong iyon, binago mo ang lambak magpakailanman.
records.englishResidueReason: The literal “Farm” is part of the protected %farm Farm runtime substitution form and must remain unchanged.

records.source: You might not realize it, but I care a lot about this town, @.#$b#%year years ago, I was deeply worried about the future of the valley.$s#$b#But now, I feel completely at ease.#$b#Who knew a humble farmer moving to town would change everything?$h#$b#...Thank you.
records.translation: Maaaring hindi mo napapansin, pero labis akong nagmamalasakit sa bayang ito, @.#$b#%year taon na ang nakalipas, labis akong nag-alala sa hinaharap ng lambak.$s#$b#Pero ngayon, ganap na akong panatag.#$b#Sino ang mag-aakalang mababago ng paglipat ng isang hamak na magsasaka sa bayan ang lahat?$h#$b#...Salamat.

records.source: Ah, @... My favorite Joja member.
records.translation: Ah, @... Ang paborito kong Miyembro ng Joja.

records.source: You know, when I was first assigned to this location over %year years ago, I considered it a step back in my career.#$b#What self-respecting Joja Manager would want to preside over a tiny, backwater location like Pelican Town?$h
records.translation: Alam mo, noong una akong italaga sa lugar na ito mahigit %year taon na ang nakalipas, itinuring ko iyong pag-urong sa karera ko.#$b#Sinong Tagapamahala ng Joja na may paggalang sa sarili ang gustong mamuno sa isang maliit at liblib na lugar gaya ng Bayan ng Pelican?$h

records.source: But I have to say, this valley has really grown on me, over the years.#$b#Working here has opened my eyes to a different way of life. It's hard to say this, but... It's been... a humbling experience.
records.translation: Pero masasabi kong napamahal na talaga sa akin ang lambak na ito sa paglipas ng mga taon.#$b#Binuksan ng pagtatrabaho rito ang mga mata ko sa ibang paraan ng pamumuhay. Mahirap sabihin ito, pero... Naging... aral ito sa pagpapakumbaba.

records.source: I just want to say, @... I appreciate all the hard work you've done for Joja Co.#$b#Our strength comes from our members, and you've shown exemplary drive and ingenuity. It makes me proud to work for the company.$h
records.translation: Gusto ko lang sabihin, @... Pinahahalagahan ko ang lahat ng pagsisikap mo para sa Joja Co.#$b#Nagmumula ang lakas namin sa mga miyembro namin, at nagpakita ka ng huwarang sigasig at pagkamalikhain. Ipinagmamalaki kong nagtatrabaho ako para sa kompanya.$h

records.source: Hey, @.
records.translation: Hoy, @.

records.source: It's so beautiful up here...
records.translation: Napakaganda rito sa itaas...

records.source: Great view, huh?
records.translation: Ang ganda ng tanawin, ha?

records.source: I was just thinking about the last %year years...
records.translation: Iniisip ko lang ang nakaraang %year taon...

records.source: We've been through a lot together, haven't we?$h
records.translation: Marami na tayong pinagdaanan, hindi ba?$h

records.source: ...But look how far we've come.
records.translation: ...Pero tingnan mo kung gaano na kalayo ang narating natin.

records.source: I've finally discovered who I want to be... and I feel certain about the future."/pause 500/speak Alex "I don't think I would've gotten here without you, @."
records.translation: Sa wakas ay natuklasan ko kung sino ang gusto kong maging... at tiyak ang loob ko tungkol sa hinaharap."/pause 500/speak Alex "Sa tingin ko ay hindi ako nakarating dito kung wala ka, @."

records.source: Before I met you, I spent most of my time turned away from reality... because I thought I'd never find happiness.#$b#...but you've shown me that the world isn't such a dark place, after all.$h"/faceDirection Sebastian 3/pause 500/speak Sebastian "...That's one of the reasons I love you..."
records.translation: Bago kita nakilala, halos buong oras ko ay ginugol ko sa pagtalikod sa realidad... dahil inakala kong hindi ko kailanman matatagpuan ang kaligayahan.#$b#...pero ipinakita mo sa akin na hindi pala ganoon kadilim ang mundo.$h"/faceDirection Sebastian 3/pause 500/speak Sebastian "...Iyan ang isa sa mga dahilan kung bakit mahal kita..."

records.source: I feel like I've changed a lot from when we first met... you know?#$b#...you might call it 'maturity'... hehe.$10#$b#But I'm at a place, now, where I'm actually really excited about our future together...$l#$b#Even if that means just doing normal stuff, like... uh... buying groceries and changing diapers... hah...$10
records.translation: Pakiramdam ko ay malaki ang ipinagbago ko mula noong una tayong nagkakilala... alam mo?#$b#...maaari mo sigurong tawagin itong 'pagkamaygulang'... hehe.$10#$b#Pero nasa yugto na ako ngayon na talagang nasasabik ako sa hinaharap nating magkasama...$l#$b#Kahit ang ibig sabihin niyon ay paggawa lang ng karaniwang bagay, gaya ng... uh... pamimili ng pagkain at pagpapalit ng lampin... hah...$10

records.source: If I hadn't met you, @... I might not even be here right now.#$b#Which would be a shame, because the bird-watching up here is phenomenal!$h"/emote farmer 16/pause 1000/speak Shane "Heh... I... I tend to joke a lot, because...well...$s#$b#I guess keeping things light-hearted makes it so I don't have to open up and make myself vulnerable."/emote Shane 28/speak Shane "But every season that goes by, with you, I get a little more comfortable with myself.#$b#Uh.. I guess what I want to say is...#$b#I have no regrets marrying you!$h"
records.translation: Kung hindi kita nakilala, @... baka wala na ako rito ngayon.#$b#Nakakapanghinayang sana iyon, dahil pambihira ang pagmamasid sa mga ibon dito sa itaas!$h"/emote farmer 16/pause 1000/speak Shane "Heh... Ako... Madalas akong magbiro dahil...buweno...$s#$b#Siguro, kapag pinananatili kong magaan ang lahat, hindi ko kailangang magbukas ng damdamin at ipakitang mahina rin ako."/emote Shane 28/speak Shane "Pero sa bawat panahong lumilipas na kasama ka, mas nagiging komportable ako sa sarili ko.#$b#Uh.. Ang gusto ko sigurong sabihin ay...#$b#Wala akong pinagsisisihan sa pagpapakasal sa iyo!$h"

records.source: Heh... it just dawned on me...$h#$b#We've reached the summit, but not just physically... metaphorically as well.#$b#How poetic!$l
records.translation: Heh... ngayon ko lang naisip...$h#$b#Narating natin ang tuktok, pero hindi lamang sa pisikal na paraan... maging sa talinghaga rin.#$b#Napakamakatula!$l

records.source: When I'm next to you, I'm not even scared of falling off this cliff and dashing onto the sharp rocks below...$l"/jump Harvey/shake Harvey 1000/pause 1000/speak Harvey "...$8#$b#I... I love and admire you very much, @...$l"
records.translation: Kapag katabi kita, hindi man lang ako natatakot na mahulog sa bangin at bumagsak sa matatalas na bato sa ibaba...$l"/jump Harvey/shake Harvey 1000/pause 1000/speak Harvey "...$8#$b#M... Mahal at labis kitang hinahangaan, @...$l"

records.source: Standing here, looking out on the horizon... I get a feeling of endless possibility.#$b#I'm just happy I get to explore this world, with you by my side...$l
records.translation: Habang nakatayo rito at nakatanaw sa abot-tanaw... nakadarama ako ng walang-hanggang posibilidad.#$b#Masaya lang akong magagalugad ko ang mundong ito na kasama ka...$l

records.source: This is a special moment...#$b#I've always known I would be standing here with you, someday. I've always felt it in my heart.#$b#Now, it's all come true."/pause 500/speak Emily "The world is a mysterious and special place...$l"
records.translation: Natatanging sandali ito...#$b#Alam ko noon pa man na balang araw ay tatayo ako rito kasama ka. Lagi ko iyong nadarama sa puso ko.#$b#Ngayon, nagkatotoo na ang lahat."/pause 500/speak Emily "Ang mundo ay mahiwaga at natatanging lugar...$l"

records.source: *giggle*... $h"/faceDirection farmer 1 true/emote farmer 8/pause 1000/speak Haley "Oh, it's just that...#$b#As a little girl, I always dreamed that one day, I would climb to the summit with my true love, and share a kiss.$l"
records.translation: *hagikgik*... $h"/faceDirection farmer 1 true/emote farmer 8/pause 1000/speak Haley "O, kasi...#$b#Noong bata pa ako, lagi kong pinapangarap na balang araw ay aakyat ako sa tuktok kasama ang tunay kong pag-ibig at maghahalik kami.$l"

records.source: I think we've both found what we were looking for in this place.#$b#I wouldn't want to be anywhere else, but here with you.$l
records.translation: Sa tingin ko ay pareho nating natagpuan ang hinahanap natin sa lugar na ito.#$b#Wala akong ibang lugar na nanaisin kundi narito kasama ka.$l

records.source: We have a beautiful home and a thriving family... it's all I've ever dreamed of, and more.$l
records.translation: Mayroon tayong magandang tahanan at masiglang pamilya... iyon ang lahat ng pinangarap ko, at higit pa.$l

records.source: You've really accomplished a lot since you moved here, @. It's incredible."/pause 300/faceDirection Maru 3/pause 400/speak Maru "I think it's safe to say that you were meant to be a farmer!$h"
records.translation: Napakarami mo talagang nagawa mula nang lumipat ka rito, @. Hindi kapani-paniwala."/pause 300/faceDirection Maru 3/pause 400/speak Maru "Masasabi kong talagang itinadhana kang maging magsasaka!$h"

records.source: It's been a long road...
records.translation: Mahaba ang naging paglalakbay...

records.source: You challenged yourself to reach the summit
records.translation: Hinarap mo ang hamon na marating ang tuktok

records.source: What an accomplishment!
records.translation: Napakalaking tagumpay!

records.source: We've been watching every step of the way
records.translation: Pinanood namin ang bawat hakbang mo

records.source: And you've made us very proud!
records.translation: At lubos kaming nagmamalaki sa iyo!
